about: The fields of the continent-v2 server rows that are not coordinates, keyed by the scene marker record_id (the marker gives the position and the tile, through _continent_v2/frames.py). publish_server.py joins the two; a marker of kind npc_marker or interactive without an entry here is refused. No field may hold '|', '#' or a line break: the server's npcs.txt and interactives.txt loaders split on the pipe and do not strip inline comments.

boarsend--npc-swineherd-gil-mast.name: Gil Mast
boarsend--npc-swineherd-gil-mast.greeting: Mind the sows. In this wood they have right of way, and they know it. The boars in the thicket are not mine; the boars would like that made clear.
boarsend--npc-swineherd-gil-mast.greetingSource: dev-server config/eloria/npc_dialogue.txt, branch feature/landfall-people (Landfall liveliness pass, owner-approved 2026-10-14)

brambleshaw--npc-toll-keeper-tobin-ware.greeting: One cask in twenty of everything that leaves the vineyards. Not you; you are not a cask. Welcome to Brambleshaw.
brambleshaw--npc-toll-keeper-tobin-ware.greetingSource: dev-server config/eloria/npc_dialogue.txt, branch feature/landfall-people (Landfall liveliness pass, owner-approved 2026-10-14)

greenlight--npc-ferryman-caldus.greeting: I keep the ferry under the green light. My lantern marks the channel when the mist closes in.
greenlight--npc-ferryman-caldus.greetingSource: the owner's pick, 2026-10-04 (continent-v2/review/isle_greetings_and_names.md section 2, the recommended line); the Four Gates line stays in the server's npcs.txt and npc_dialogue.txt for the rollback

greenlight--npc-causeway-warden-edda-tin.name: Edda Tine
greenlight--npc-causeway-warden-edda-tin.greeting: Halfway. The arches ring when the tide turns, and I light the lamps by the note. Stand a while; the causeway is longer than it looks from either end.
greenlight--npc-causeway-warden-edda-tin.greetingSource: dev-server config/eloria/npc_dialogue.txt, branch feature/landfall-people (Landfall liveliness pass, owner-approved 2026-10-14)

greenlight--obj-ferry-n10.text: The Landfall ferry rides at the green light's quay, bound for Crownwater. Ferryman Caldus keeps the gangplank.

hearthcroft--npc-crofter-oyun-tarag.greeting: Five roads meet at my gate, and every one of them arrives hungry. Sit. The soup is barley and it costs nothing, which on this isle takes some explaining.
hearthcroft--npc-crofter-oyun-tarag.greetingSource: dev-server config/eloria/npc_dialogue.txt, branch feature/landfall-people (Landfall liveliness pass, owner-approved 2026-10-14)

landfall--npc-cape-seller-mara-vell.name: Mara Vell
landfall--npc-cape-seller-mara-vell.greeting: A cape for your calling. Each carries one perk tier; it helps even when you have mastered the perk yourself.

landfall--npc-toolkeeper-rowan-hale.name: Rowan Hale
landfall--npc-toolkeeper-rowan-hale.greeting: Welcome to Rowan's Tools. Pickaxes, hatchets and the tools for your next trade, all at a fair price.

landfall--npc-bettany-orl.name: Bettany Orl
landfall--npc-bettany-orl.greeting: Bread, broth, and whatever the last boat was willing to say out loud. The broth is better.
landfall--npc-bettany-orl.greetingSource: the owner's pick, 2026-10-04 (continent-v2/review/isle_greetings_and_names.md section 2, the recommended line); the Four Gates line stays in the server's npcs.txt and npc_dialogue.txt for the rollback

landfall--npc-gate-warden-ilyon.name: Gate Warden Ilyon
landfall--npc-gate-warden-ilyon.greeting: Every people keeps a post on this isle. Keep your weapons low and your purpose clear, and we will get on.
landfall--npc-gate-warden-ilyon.greetingSource: the owner's pick, 2026-10-04 (continent-v2/review/isle_greetings_and_names.md section 2, the recommended line); the Four Gates line stays in the server's npcs.txt and npc_dialogue.txt for the rollback

landfall--npc-grove-keeper-ammet-sorrel.name: Ammet Sorrel
landfall--npc-grove-keeper-ammet-sorrel.greeting: Pick from the low branches. The high ones belong to the palace, and the palace has not looked up in two hundred years.

landfall--npc-register-clerk-hemmen.name: Hemmen
landfall--npc-register-clerk-hemmen.greeting: The Landing Register is the only document all eight peoples ever agreed to sign. Mind how you write in it.
landfall--npc-register-clerk-hemmen.greetingSource: the owner's pick, 2026-10-04 (continent-v2/review/isle_greetings_and_names.md section 2, the recommended line); the Four Gates line stays in the server's npcs.txt and npc_dialogue.txt for the rollback

landfall--npc-temple-warden-ostrid-holli.name: Ostrid Hollin
landfall--npc-temple-warden-ostrid-holli.greeting: Whoever falls on this isle wakes by the beacon, a stone's throw from my door. I count them in. I have not yet had to count anyone out.

landfall--npc-wayfinder-nesh.name: Nash
landfall--npc-wayfinder-nesh.greeting: New ashore? Then start where everyone does, and I will not have to fish you out of the lake.
landfall--npc-wayfinder-nesh.greetingSource: the owner's pick, 2026-10-04 (continent-v2/review/isle_greetings_and_names.md section 2, the recommended line); the Four Gates line stays in the server's npcs.txt and npc_dialogue.txt for the rollback

stagheath--npc-tavi-unhar.name: Tavi Unhar
stagheath--npc-tavi-unhar.greeting: Forty-one hulls since dawn. I am not hiding. I am counting.
